inspiration.observed_pattern: PERCENTILE_DISC selects a discrete ordered value per partition at a requested percentile.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored queue with four priorities so descending discrete median selection remains observable without copying source data.

fixture_notes: Four priorities make the discrete median select the upper middle value in descending order.
determinism_notes: All queue rows, priority values, percentile, partitioning, ordering, and output ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE queue_jobs (job_id INT PRIMARY KEY, queue_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, job_no INT NOT NULL, priority_score INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT queue_code, job_no, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY priority_score DESC) OVER (PARTITION BY queue_code) AS median_priority FROM queue_jobs ORDER BY queue_code, job_no
